text:
maria: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged a small spike on canary v2.1.3-hotfix during the 5% rollout. Change window ends in ~45m. Requesting quick stop/go.

deploy-bot: [auto] Canary traffic: 5% -> errors ↑ 0.9% (baseline 0.2%), p95 latency +120ms. Event ID db3f4. No automatic rollback triggered. See /deploy 12345 for details.

aaron: can you paste the metric links?

maria: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/canary/12345 — spike aligns with KV cache evictions on the new binary. QPS itself looks stable.

ben: given it's +0.7% error that's borderline for user impact. Do we know error class? 5xx or client 4xx?

lisa: 5xx, mostly 502/504 from the edge -> downstream timeouts to embeddings-service. Stack traces show timeouts when cache misses spike.

jeff: my read: hold at 5% until we root-cause the downstream timeout source. No rollforward. Pin versions and block further percentage increases.

maria: ack. I'll pin rollout to the previous stable (v2.1.2) as a fallback and revert canary to that if needed.

maria: command I'm about to run: `rollout pin --deployment inference-canary --version v2.1.2 --reason "edge 5xx spike"`

deploy-bot: [action] Rollout pinned to v2.1.2 by maria at 1800004380. Canary traffic frozen at 5%.

aaron: I'll kick KV cache mitigation: bump cache TTLs and pre-warm the new replicas, and patch the embedding client retry window. ETA ~20m.

ben: release notes: add an incident note and explicit rollback criteria (error >0.5% sustained for 20m or p95 > +100ms). I'll update the docs.

product: FYI — hold any other change windows for this slot until we confirm user-visible error <0.1% for a rolling 30m window.

lisa: ops will monitor dashboards. If errors don't return to baseline by +40m from now we trigger a full rollback off canary to v2.1.2 across the region.

jeff: good. @maria can you spin up a postmortem thread with the hypothesis and timeline once Aaron posts mitigation results? We want the RCA link in release notes.

maria: will do — creating the postmortem now and linking telemetry and logs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
